content.title: About
content.content: Whiskey is a distilled spirit made from fermented grain mash, while diet cola is a calorie‑free carbonated soft drink sweetened with artificial sweeteners. The combination is a popular highball cocktail, offering the smoky, woody notes of whiskey balanced by the light, sweet fizz of diet cola.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whiskey can be aged in oak barrels from 3 up to 30+ years, which profoundly influences flavor and aroma.
Diet cola was first introduced in the 1960s as a response to growing demand for low‑calorie beverages.
The whiskey‑and‑diet‑cola highball is especially popular among those who want a lower‑calorie mixed drink.
Artificial sweeteners such as aspartame or sucralose do not raise blood sugar, making the drink suitable for people monitoring glycemic intake.
Alcohol combined with sweeteners can enhance perceived sweetness, making the cocktail taste less bitter.

items.title: Relaxation in moderation
items.content: Small amounts of alcohol have a mild sedative effect that can help reduce stress.

items.title: Low‑calorie option
items.content: Using diet cola keeps the drink’s calorie count low, which can aid in weight management when consumed responsibly.

items.title: Antioxidants in whiskey
items.content: Whiskey contains polyphenols that may provide antioxidant benefits when consumed in moderate amounts.

items.title: Alcohol‑related risks
items.content: Excessive whiskey consumption can lead to dependence, liver damage, and other health issues.

items.title: Artificial sweetener concerns
items.content: Some individuals may experience headaches or digestive discomfort from certain sweeteners.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Alcohol can amplify the effects of various medications; consult a healthcare professional if needed.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Cola’s acidity may irritate the stomach lining when consumed frequently.

content.title: How to Drink
content.content: Pour 40–50 ml of whiskey over ice in a highball glass, add 150–200 ml of diet cola, and stir gently. A wedge of lemon or lime can be added for extra aroma. Sip slowly and limit intake to 1–2 servings per day.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store whiskey in a cool, dark place with the bottle tightly sealed. Keep opened diet cola refrigerated to preserve carbonation and flavor, and avoid exposing it to high temperatures.
